data.name: AllCategories
data.comment: First entry of the category filter; selecting it removes the category restriction.

data.name: AmountMustBePositive
data.value: Enter an amount greater than zero.

data.name: CsvFileFilter
data.comment: SaveFileDialog filter: display name|pattern pairs separated by |; keep the patterns.

data.name: DeleteManyPrompt
data.comment: {0} is the number of selected rows (2 or more).

data.name: EditTransactionTitle
data.comment: Window title of the transaction dialog when editing an existing row.

data.name: EndBeforeStart
data.value: The end date is before the start date.

data.name: ExportDone
data.comment: {0} is the number of rows, {1} the file path.

data.name: ExportFailed
data.value: The export failed and no file was written to {0}: {1}
data.comment: {0} is the chosen file path, {1} the system's error message.

data.name: ExportTitle
data.comment: Title of the save-file dialog.

data.name: LastMonth
data.comment: First entry of the Reports month selector: the month ending today.

data.name: LastYear
data.comment: First entry of the Reports year selector: the 12 months ending today.

data.name: LegendExpenses
data.comment: Chart legend entry for the expenses series.

data.name: LegendIncome
data.comment: Chart legend entry for the income series.

data.name: LegendNet
data.comment: Chart legend entry for the net (income minus expenses) series.

data.name: PeriodMonth
data.comment: Reports period kind: one calendar month, or the last month.

data.name: PeriodRange
data.comment: Reports: the dates a period covers. {0} is the first date, {1} the last (both yyyy-MM-dd).

data.name: PeriodTimeline
data.comment: Reports period kind: from the first to the last transaction.

data.name: PeriodYear
data.comment: Reports period kind: one calendar year, or the last year.

data.name: TotalRow
data.comment: Label of the last row of the Reports table, which sums each period column.

data.name: ViewBarChart
data.comment: Entry of the Reports view selector: income and expenses as bars.

data.name: ViewLineChart
data.comment: Entry of the Reports view selector: income, expenses and net as lines.

data.name: ViewTable
data.comment: Entry of the Reports view selector: net per category and period as a table.
